topic: The Pioneer anomaly — when spacecraft drifted off course

beats.narration: Pioneer 10 and 11 drifted slightly off their predicted paths.
beats.image_prompt: vintage 1970s spacecraft in deep space, golden antenna dish, stars in background, cinematic, no people

beats.narration: For years, physicists wondered if new physics was needed to explain the tiny extra acceleration toward the Sun.
beats.image_prompt: scientific equation sketches and spacecraft trajectory plots on paper, dramatic desk lighting, no people

beats.narration: The leading explanation today is heat recoiling unevenly from the spacecraft itself — not new gravity.
beats.image_prompt: spacecraft thermal radiation visualization in deep space, subtle glow, technical cutaway style, no people

beats.narration: A mystery that looked revolutionary was solved by careful engineering physics.
beats.image_prompt: distant probe leaving the solar system, pale sunlight, vast empty space, contemplative wide shot, no people
